topic: Filtering inventory and company visibility for users
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on improving user visibility and filtering capabilities within the platform, particularly for inventory and company data. Currently, the system shows all traffic/inventory/companies to administrators (admin view). A key requirement is the ability to exclude specific companies or facility types (e.g., old TP-link boxes, certain older locations) from a user's view, even in admin mode.

Regarding multi-company access for a single user, [me] suggested providing a mapping table (`user_id` -> `company_id`, optionally including `facility_id`) to manage visibility without requiring UI changes. The alternative was implementing this functionality directly into the system's backend logic.

It was noted that adding exclusion rules for companies/facilities would require expanding current functional capabilities, as the existing system only supports adding or limiting by specific facilities or native companies.
decisions: The need to filter out certain company types and old hardware (like TP-link boxes) from general user views was established.
action_items: Someone needs to investigate implementing a mechanism for users to select/filter specific companies or facilities, potentially using an exclusion list.
A mapping table structure (`user_id; company_id; facility_id`) was proposed by [me] to manage user-company access.
